# China to provide 5,000 AI training opportunities for developing countries: Xi

gov.cn (State Council portal), Xinhua, updated July 17, 2026 (11:47). Full article retrieved.

## Key findings
- At the opening ceremony of the **2026 World AI Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance** (Shanghai), President **Xi Jinping** announced that China will provide developing countries with **5,000 opportunities for AI training and seminars over the next five years**.
- China will develop **international AI application cooperation centers** with: ASEAN, the League of Arab States, the African Union, the Community of Latin American and Caribbean States (CELAC), the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO), and BRICS.
- China will help **30 countries** utilize the AI-powered **MAZU meteorological early warning system** to protect people's lives and property around the world.
